subject: Short credit top-up request for POC load/latency validation
messages:
From: Anne Bates <anne.bates@fintechx.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 3 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC load test — short credit top-up request

Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We pushed a quick internal plan to validate throughput/latency at scale and realized the trial credits will run out mid-run. Our SRE Lucas wants to run a 2-hour stress window at ~600 concurrent streams to validate tail latency and KV-cache behavior. Can Redwood provide a top-up for the POC so we can finish the tests?

Estimate: ~200k tokens (inference) / ~50k request units — roughly $2.5k of spend. Hoping for a one-time promotional credit or trial extension through Mar 10 so we can complete the validation.

Attached is our POC test plan and endpoint details. Happy to sign an MPO or a quick mutual action plan if needed.

Best,
Anne Bates
Director of Platform Engineering
FintechX
[Attachment: FintechX-POC-plan.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: marissa.cole@redwood.ai <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Anne Bates <anne.bates@fintechx.com>
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai, monica.patel@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 3 Mar 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC load test — short credit top-up request

Anne — appreciate the clear estimate and the plan. This is exactly the kind of validation we want customers to run. I can approve a promotional top-up but need a quick green light from Rishi (discount/credit approvals for >$2k). Also copying Monica from Solutions so we can coordinate any config knobs (batching/kv cache) to keep latency representative.

If it's helpful, we can limit the credit to only the specific project/team and set an expiry (say Mar 10) so it doesn’t get used elsewhere. Can you confirm: 1) final token estimate (200k ok?), 2) which endpoint/region you'll test in (us-west-2?), and 3) a primary contact for the run (Lucas)?

If Rishi approves, I'll handle the credit issuance and send an updated usage schedule + link to the test cluster.

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole | Sr. Account Exec, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198
Redwood Inference

From: rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Cc: Anne Bates <anne.bates@fintechx.com>, monica.patel@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 4 Mar 2026 08:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC load test — short credit top-up request

Marissa / Anne — approved.

We will provision a one-time promotional credit of $3,000 (applied as account credit) limited to the FintechX POC workspace. Expiry: 2026-03-10 23:59 PT. This should cover the estimated 200k tokens and give a small buffer. Conditions:
- Credit is non-transferable and applies only to the project code FINX-POC-RWD-3812.
- If the run triggers sustained sustained throughput that impacts capacity, Redwood may reach out to coordinate a short outage window — but we do not expect that for the planned test.

Marissa — please create the promo code / account credit and confirm when applied. Monica — please flag any config recommendations (batching/kv cache settings) for Lucas to avoid artificially optimistic latency.

Rishi Malhotra
Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai

From: marissa.cole@redwood.ai <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Anne Bates <anne.bates@fintechx.com>, Lucas Chen <lucas.chen@fintechx.com>
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai, monica.patel@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 5 Mar 2026 15:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC load test — short credit top-up request

Anne / Lucas — credit has been applied. Details below: 

- Amount: $3,000 promotional credit (project: FINX-POC-RWD-3812)
- Applied to: fintechx-poc@redwood (project workspace)
- Expiry: 2026-03-10T23:59:00-07:00
- Promo ID: PROMO-RWD-2026-03-3812

I uploaded a usage snapshot for the trial cluster so you can baseline token burn: redwood-usage-snapshot.csv (attached). Monica included a short checklist: set continuous batching to medium, enable prefix KV cache, and cap concurrent_streams to 700 for the test window to mimic expected production load.

Small ask: after the run could you share the tail latency distribution (p95/p99) and an export of request IDs so our performance team can correlate infra traces — this helps with any follow-ups on kernel/kv tuning.

Let me know if you want a short hands-on with Solutions during the run — Monica is available tomorrow afternoon. Good luck with the run.

Best,
Marissa
[Attachment: redwood-usage-snapshot.csv (text/csv)]
